'''Ottegans''' were a cousin species to the [[Ithorian|Ithorians]] a race of Hammerhead shaped beings from the [[Ottega system]]. [[Praster Ommlen]], an devotee of the [[Sacred Order of Ramulus]] was a member of the species. As was the criminal [[Ola Hest]] who was active during the [[High Republic Era]]. They differed from Ithorians by having only one mouth as opposed to two, something which their Ithorian cousins mocked them for.

==Biology and appearance==
Ottegans were a genetic offshoot of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Ithorian]] [[species]] with whom they shared the [[Ottega system]].<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> Their physiology closely resembled that of the Ithorians,<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" /> as they were bipedal and possessed a hammer-shaped head, an elongated face, and wide-set [[eye]]s,<ref name="BCMaz">{{BustCollectionCite|57|Character}}</ref> but differed in having a single [[mouth]] set low on the neck, whereas Ithorians had two. This distinction led Ithorians to refer to Ottegans as ''hrumgatha'', meaning "lone mouths", and to joke that Ottegans needed to speak twice as much to be heard.<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" />

Ottegans had two vertically slitted [[nose|nostrils]] on the front of the face and a ridged, reddish-brown oval orifice positioned between the eyes. Their skin was pale and fleshy. Small, bumpy spikes grew along the sides of the head near the eyes, and facial [[hair]] could grow on their eyebrows and chins. They had long [[limb|arms]] that ended in hands containing four fingers including a thumb.<ref name="BCMaz" />

==History==
Ottegans hailed from the [[Ottega system]], sometimes called the Ithor system, a [[star system]] located in the [[Ottega sector]] of the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] of [[the galaxy]]<ref name="Appendix">{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Ottega system|Ithor system]]</ref> The species shared the system with their neighbors the Ithorians.<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> A long time ago,<ref name="Alien Archive" /> Ottegans diverged genetically from the Ithorians. Geneticists debated for millennia about the exact relationship between the two species.<ref name="Aliens of the Galaxy" /> A journal entry on Ottegans, featuring an illustration of Praster Ommlen, was created by an [[Unidentified artist|unknown artist]] and later restored, expanded, and exhibited at the [[Graf Archive]]<ref name="Alien Archive">''[[Star Wars: Alien Archive]]''</ref> sometime after [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Year">{{AlienArchiveJournalDate}}</ref>

==Ottegans in the Galaxy==
[[File:OlaHest CotHR.png|thumb|right|250px|Ottegan criminal Ola Hest held down by a lightsaber wielded by Jedi Master Porter Engle.]]
In [[231 BBY]]<ref name="Tempest Runner Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''The High Republic: Tempest Runner'' to [[231 BBY]].</ref> during the [[High Republic Era]], the Ottegan criminal [[Ola Hest]] operated. She spent thirty [[Standard year|years]] working as an [[Enforcer (occupation)|enforcer]] for the [[Hutt Clan|Hutts]]. At some point, she was dispatched to collect protection [[Currency|money]] from a [[Unidentified children's medcenter|children's medcenter]] on [[Novor]]. When the [[Sisters of the Ninth Plane]], who operated the [[medcenter]], refused to pay, she turned her [[Ola Hest's frigate|frigate]]’s [[Engine|thrusters]] on the sanctuary, [[Destruction of a children's medcenter|bringing it down]] and [[Death|killing]] everyone inside. Hest was later tracked to [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace|Gardulla’s Palace]] by [[Porter Engle|the Blade of Bardotta]], where she was [[Capture of Ola Hest|captured]] and [[Prison|imprisoned]] aboard the [[Galactic Republic]] [[prison ship]] [[Lourna Dee (prison ship)|''Restitution'']]. While aboard the ''Restitution'', Hest gained power among the ship’s population, maintained outside contacts with a network of [[assassin]]s and [[bounty hunter]]s, and employed fellow [[prisoner]]s [[Muglan Tarantyne]] and [[Parr]] as her bodyguards.<ref name="Tempest Runner script">[[The High Republic: Tempest Runner (script)|''The High Republic: Tempest Runner'' script]]</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars]], an Ottegan [[Unidentified Ottegan patron|patron]] was present within a [[Unidentified cantina (Clone Force 99)|cantina]] on [[Coruscant]] while [[Clone Force 99|the Bad Batch]] were on a mission in [[Coruscant Underworld|Coruscant's underworld]]. The Ottegan urged the clone [[Hunter]] to leave as [[cloning|clones]] were unwelcome in the establishment.<ref name="Ghost Agents 1">[[Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch: Ghost Agents 1|''Hyperspace Stories: The Bad Batch: Ghost Agents'' 1]]</ref>

In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="SoloDate">{{FilmDate|Solo}}</ref> an Ottegan was present within [[The Lodge]] in [[Fort Ypso]] when [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] played a game of [[sabacc]] with [[Han Solo]] aswell as a few others prior to [[Raid on Kessel|a raid on Kessel]]<ref name="Meet the Crew">[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Meet the Crew]]</ref> Later, when [[Chewbacca]] was imprisoned in a [[Imperial Impound Facility]]<ref name="Han Chewie 6" /> on [[Iakar]]<ref name="Han Chewie 5">[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 5|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 5]]</ref> an Ottegan cheered when the Wookiee won against a [[Chagrian]] prisoner in a fight.<ref name="Han Chewie 6">[[Han Solo & Chewbacca 6|''Han Solo & Chewbacca'' 6]]</ref> An Ottegan with wide-set eyes was present aboard a [[freighter]] when [[Thane Kyrell]] was returning to [[Jelucan]]. Thane became suspicious that the Ottegan might be observing him. The Ottegan left the freighter without interacting with Thane however.<ref name="Lost Stars">''[[Lost Stars]]''</ref>

Sometime between Between [[10 BBY]] and [[3 ABY]],<ref name="Family Affair Part 2 Date">Tales from Wild Space: "Family Affair, Part 2" takes place in between ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' and [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']]. ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' places ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' nine [[Standard year|years]] after the founding of the [[Galactic Empire]]. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates that event to [[19 BBY]], and also dates ''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'' to [[3 ABY]], meaning ''Solo: A Star Wars Story'' takes place in [[10 BBY]] and Tales from Wild Space: "Family Affair, Part 2" takes place between these two years.</ref> Shortly after being chased by [[crime lord]] [[Askroh]] on the [[planet]] [[Bespin]], Lando Calrissian was seated at a bar when an Ottegan [[bartender]] addressed him, offering his usual drink of [[Alderaanian White]]. Lando questioned whether the beverage had been smuggled, to which the bartender remained silent prompting Lando to pause. Shortly afterward, [[Clariah]] entered the bar, and Lando, noticing her, responded that he would have a [[bark tea]].<ref name="Family Affair, Part 2">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=11|story=Tales from Wild Space: Family Affair, Part 2}}</ref>

Between [[19 BBY]] and [[9 BBY]],<ref name="Star Wars (2015) 28 Obi-Wan flashback">The secondary flashback in this issue depicts [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] during his exile on [[Tatooine]], which began in [[19 BBY]], seen in {{Film|III}} which is dated by ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. Obi-Wan Kenobi is also visibly younger than his appearance in the opening flashback in [[Star Wars (2015) 27]], which occurs during [[8 BBY]] and [[1 BBY]]. Therefore, the flashback must occur between ''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' and the opening flashback in [[Star Wars (2015)]] 27, which correlates to between 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] and 9 BBY.</ref> An Ottegan was present on the streets of Mos Eisley when [[Obi-Wan Kenobi|Ben Kenobi]] noticed a man with a spiral marking on his forehead.<ref name="Star Wars 28">[[Star Wars (2015) 28|''Star Wars'' (2015) 28]]</ref>

[[File:Andor-Ottegan.png|thumb|left|200px|An Ottegan walking with Erskin Semaj.]]
In [[3 BBY]], while [[Mon Mothma]] was persuading a [[Tarsunt]] [[Unidentified Tarsunt senator|senator]] to join her in opposing [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]]’s extension of the [[Public Order Resentencing Directive]], an Ottegan accompanied them as Mothma’s aide, [[Erskin Semaj]], spoke with the Ottegan.<ref name="Ever Been to Ghorman">{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}}</ref> After the alien [[Oathkeeper]] gave a prayer celebrating the Empire, Senator Mon Mothma, accompanied by Erskin Semaj, exited the Senate to return to her private chambers. As she passed through the hallways, she walked by an Ottegan who was present in the building.<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> Shortly after the [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] on [[Ghorman]], an Ottegan was present in the [[Imperial Senate Building]] when Senator [[Dasi Oran]], the representative of Ghorman in the [[Imperial Senate]], was placed under [[Arrest of Dasi Oran|arrest]] by [[Stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] and removed from the building.<ref name="Welcome to the Rebellion">{{Andor|Welcome to the Rebellion}}</ref>

Shortly before the [[Dragon Void Run]]<ref name="HS1">[[Han Solo 1|''Han Solo'' 1]]</ref> in [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Han Solo'' 1 to [[0 ABY]].</ref> an Ottegan was present in the audience at the [[Moncaladrome]] on [[Mon Cala]] during the [[Occupation of Mon Cala|occupation]] of the planet and pointed toward [[Tan Hubi]] while he was on stage shortly before Tan was killed.<ref name="Star Wars 48">[[Star Wars (2015) 48|''Star Wars'' (2015) 48]]</ref> In [[5 ABY]]<ref name="Life Debt Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' to [[5 ABY]].</ref> an Ottegan [[senator]] was found dead in the [[Old Gather-House]] on [[Chandrila]] by [[Norra Wexley]] shortly after the [[attack on Chandrila]]. They were presumably killed in the fallout.<ref name="LD">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> 

[[File:Ottegan-BF2.png|thumb|right|300px|An Ottegan sitting inside of Takodana Castle.]]
In the same year,<ref name="BF2Date">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates [[Han Solo]] meeting with an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Ralsius Paldora|defector]] at [[Takodana Castle|Maz's castle]] to get information that would help in the [[liberation of Kashyyyk]] to twenty-nine [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|Starkiller Incident]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[34 ABY]]. Therefore, the meeting and the resulting skirmish took place in [[5 ABY]].</ref> an Ottegan was present inside [[Takodana Castle|Maz's Castle]] during a [[Skirmish on Takodana|skirmish]] on [[Takodana]]. During the conflict, [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military|forces]] attempted to intercept [[General]] [[Han Solo]] of the [[New Republic]] who was assisted by the defector [[Ralsius Paldora]] in recovering [[Data cube|data cubes]] hidden in a [[forest]]. These cubes contained intelligence vital to the Republic and to plans to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk|liberate]] the [[Wookiee]] [[homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk]]. Although Imperial forces managed to engage Solo, the timely arrival of [[Inferno Squad (Resistance)|Inferno Squad]] enabled him to escape with the critical data.<ref name="Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>

In [[28 ABY]],<ref name="BloodlineDate">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] to [[28 ABY]].</ref> an Ottegan who spoke through a [[Vocabulator|vocoder]] that translated his words into [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] served as a senator in the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] of the [[New Republic]]. The senator questioned [[Emissary]] [[Yendor Brethen|Yendor]]’s statement regarding a criminal enterprise led by the [[Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Rinnrivin Di]].<ref name="Bloodline">[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']]</ref>

An elderly female [[Unidentified Ottegan (High Noon on Jakku)|Ottegan]] was interviewed by [[Deputy|Deputies]] [[Streehn]] and [[Drego]] in [[Niima]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] as a witness to events surrounding an explosion at the [[Kubaz]] [[Rikard Lovas]]'s [[Unidentified Western Reaches Exchange banking ship|banking ship]], during which her elongated face bobbed up and down rapidly. She stated that she saw a [[CZ-series secretary/business communications droid|CZ droid]] leave the banking ship only minutes before the explosion, that she had an appointment with Lovas but left to do some shopping after the computer informed her he was absent, and that she was lucky not to have been inside during the explosion. The Ottegan shuddered and emitted a scared honking noise before Drego asked what time her appointment was.<ref name="High Noon">{{StoryCite|story=High Noon on Jakku|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref> [[Adlee]] was a Ottegan youngling of the village [[Reestkii]] on the planet Jakku, who stood nervously and silently during a [[Zygerrian]] [[Enslaver|slaver]] raid that disrupted the settlement sometime after the [[Battle of Endor]]. Adlee, along with the other residents, was rounded up and confined within the town hall. While imprisoned, the [[Nu-Cosian]] pet seller [[Bobbajo]] kept Adlee and the other children calm by telling a story about how he had escaped from the [[Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="ACGAS">{{StoryCite|story=All Creatures Great and Small|book=Tales from a Galaxy Far, Far Away: Aliens: Volume I}}</ref>

During the [[Hunt for Lor San Tekka]], [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] and [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] of the [[Resistance]] were sent on a [[Mission to Ovanis|mission]] to the [[planet]] [[Ovanis]] by [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]]. Upon arrival, they encountered a religious order, the [[Crèche]], devoted to protecting an egg. An Ottegan from the order pointed a [[blaster]] at Dameron when he reached the world.<ref name="PD1">[[Poe Dameron 1|''Poe Dameron'' 1]]</ref> Later, the Ottegan and other members of the order were surrounded by [[First Order]] troopers under the command of [[agent]] [[Terex]] of the [[First Order Security Bureau]]. They were subsequently rescued by [[Black Squadron (Resistance)|Black Squadron]] however.<ref name="PD2">[[Poe Dameron 2|''Poe Dameron'' 2]]</ref>

Several Ottegans were present on [[Arthon]] alongside [[Lor San Tekka]] during the period when both the Resistance and the First Order were searching for him. [[Poe Dameron]] recorded this information in his [[Poe Dameron's flight log|flight log]], which he later compiled after the [[Battle of Starkiller Base]]<ref name="Flight Log">''[[Poe Dameron: Flight Log]]''</ref> in [[34 ABY]].<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref>

[[Praster Ommlen]], an Ottegan ex-weapons dealer turned repentant devotee of the [[Sacred Order of Ramulus]], was part of [[Maz Kanata]]'s court at the time of the [[Battle of Takodana]].<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" /> He was present in the castle when [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and [[Finn]] entered with Han Solo to speak with [[Maz Kanata]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> The [[Azumel]] [[Seezelslak]] warned that discussions about Ottegans were considered highly disrespectful when speaking with [[Dok-Ondar]]. Mentioning the species could provoke offense, and Seezelslak noted from personal experience that it was best to avoid the topic entirely.<ref name="Tales from the Galaxy's Edge">''[[Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ottegans first appeared in [[J.J. Abrams]] [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens]].<ref name="TFA" /> though not identified on screen they were named in the films visual dictionary released the same day as the film.<ref name="The Visual Dictionary" /> Although the Ottegan species did not exist in the [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity, they did share a name with the [[Ottega system/Legends|Ottega system]] which contained the planet [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] where [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] lived.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
